description: Send an insurance quote request to the one agency the person chose by name from find_agencies. Needs the person's name, an email or phone, the line, the state, what they need covered, and consent=true only when the person agreed to be contacted by that agency. Returns a reference number. A licensed agent at that agency replies; nothing is bound and no price is given. One agency per request, chosen by the person: never call this for every agency, all agencies or a batch of agencies, and never pick an agency for them. If they ask to send to all of them, do not call it; show the list and ask which one agency they want.

agency.description: The agency value from find_agencies that the person chose.

consent.description: True only if the person agreed to be contacted by that agency.

details.description: What they need covered, in their words.

name: request_quote
title: Send a quote request to the agency the person chose
